skill.ashen.mage_19.description: After a 150ms arcane wind-up, Blink up to 16 blocks in/nthe direction you are looking, including vertical aim./nPass through walls without requiring a clear path./nThe destination must fit your body and remain within/nworld bounds./nDefault key: Z (configurable in Controls)./nCooldown: 3s./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).
skill.ashen.ranger_19.description: Gain Speed II for 15 seconds./nGain Slow Falling for 15 seconds./nCannot be refreshed while active./nDefault key: X (configurable in Controls)./nCooldown: 8s after the buff ends./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).
skill.ashen.ranger_21.description: Make nearby creatures within 12 blocks glow for 12/nseconds./nDefault key: C (configurable in Controls)./nCooldown: 5s./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).
skill.ashen.rogue_19.description: Jump once more while airborne./nThe extra jump resets when you land./nCannot be used while swimming, riding or gliding./nAllocating this node makes the first 8 blocks of any/nfall safe./nLarger drops still deal fall damage./nUnlocks Epic Fight Phantom Ascent./nEquips it into an empty Mover slot./nWhen equipped, combat-mode Jump and V share the same/nextra-jump allowance./nDefault key: V (configurable in Controls)./nCooldown: 0s./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).
skill.ashen.rogue_20.description: Requires an Epic Fight lock-on or aimed living target/nwithin 12 blocks./nBlink behind the target without requiring a clear path./nThe landing must be unobstructed./nApply Shadow Mark: the target takes 25% more damage for/n5 seconds./nGain true invisibility for 3 seconds./nClear mob aggro and prevent targeting while invisible./nDefault key: B (configurable in Controls)./nCooldown: 2s./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).
skill.ashen.mage_20.description: Gain an Energy Shield after 5 damage-free seconds./nEnergy Shield absorbs up to 30 damage, after armor and/nordinary absorption./nThe shield lasts 10 seconds or until depleted./nOn expiry or depletion, burst the absorbed damage to/nhostile mobs within 4 blocks./nAfter each burst, rearm after another 5 damage-free/nseconds./nUnlocks Epic Fight's Adaptive Skin passive: resistance/nagainst recently received damage types./nAutomatically equipped into an empty matching slot./nChange your selection in Epic Fight Skills./nPassive: no activation or cooldown./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).
skill.ashen.mage_21.description: Gain 5% spell power per 10% total mana regeneration./nIncludes the base 100% regeneration./nAt 120% total regeneration: +60% spell power./nScales continuously with regeneration from your entire/nbuild./nPassive: no activation or cooldown./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).

skill.ashen.warrior_20.description: Gain 4 Fortify (absorption health)./nConsumed Fortify refills after 5 damage-free seconds./nStacks with absorption from other sources./nPassive: no activation or cooldown./nCosts 1 main-tree points (including travel nodes).

Hits refresh the duration./nOnly the first stack on an unpoisoned enemy deals 200%/nmore poison damage (3x)./nThis poison affects poison-immune enemies./nPoison spreads once per second to enemies and training/ndummies./nSpread range: 4 blocks between their hitboxes./nSpread copies ALL stacks, their damage and remaining/nduration./nStronger infections upgrade weaker ones without/nduplicating stacks./nFirst poisoning causes no blast or area damage./nPassive: no activation or cooldown./nCosts 1 subclass point (separate pool).
